notes.title: POSTWORLD is RELEASED!
notes.content:
Hello, survivors! 

POSTWORLD is released! Reeeeeeeeeeeeee! ːsteamhappyː

Go buy it! Leave review! This all will really help to make the game much better!
We even have postapocalyptic hype train specially for this event!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/0c0b8a9ffdd40e300c905d0aef28a59d717153c8.jpg[/img]

Also Beta test ends today. Overall we are very happy with the results because:
[olist]
[*] We fixed more than 100 critical bugs and minor issues that could really DESTROY our game at launch day
[*] We polished and added even more content during those 7 beta updates
[*] We improved game balanced taking into account how you played 
[/olist]
Check out changes by yourself: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1707314220600584578]1[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1707314220616140831]2[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1707314220645938853]3[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1697181755657480204]4[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1697181755677568697]5[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1699434823061848348]6[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/postworld/announcements/detail/1699434823065067692]7[/url].

[i]TNC Base[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/53bcde3d9ce83b9615e18c12e9fa7157a3bb2be1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/a09d5d730f226c96819dd52f1ccd6bcd70cdb905.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/df48e1c088b60c4ee020331ca0b1fe3ff8c179fd.jpg[/img]

This time we have not only the levels though :) Guess what is next? And how much will it cost? ːsteamhappyː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/408035e520ad0c28183204097407c66ce6e3dc18.jpg[/img]

Now lets jump to the technical side of things.

We tried as hard as we can to optimize Nuclear Power Plant and Train levels so they have solid 50-60 FPS now. Yay!

Also we finished music system so now you can experience different sounds  when in peaceful and combat states. 

We are working on English voice over! One cool guy is helping us with English voice over. He is from England originally so we are sure in final quality.

We remember that our game has 3 factions. You can join one of them during one playthrough. These are Railwaymen, Slavers and Cultists.

Railwaymen quests are completely ready! Yes, you heard that right, POSTWORLD can be beaten already if you decide to join Railwaymen faction. 
Slavers quests and completely ready too! Yes, POSTWORLD also can be beaten if you decide to join Slavers faction.

Only one faction left is Cultists. There is not so much work left to do actually so pretty soon we will will all quests.

You probably have not yet seen in-game journal and reputation UI. In the journal you can look at the available and finished quests. In the reputation window you can look at your reputation. You can become an enemy to any of faction at any moment so it is completely up to you what to do!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/77dd31ff21bd3625cd0449f64182d59eecf597e9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149934/10bb2c6ba7fb4c5f6bf727e632a7f8475c4fa030.jpg[/img]

Expect next development progress in the next month!

Peace,
Screwdriver Entertainment Team
